payload.text: I am building a tool for independent podcasters. They upload an episode audio file, we transcribe it, and we suggest short clips they can post to social media. The target user is a solo podcaster with under five thousand listeners an episode. Not networks, not enterprise, and I do not want an enterprise tier at any point. Episodes run forty to ninety minutes. English only at launch and we will think about other languages later. Self-serve signup, monthly subscription, they cancel themselves without talking to anyone. The clips need to be genuinely good, not random thirty-second chunks, because that is the whole product. And turnaround should feel fast enough that somebody can upload after recording and post clips the same evening.

Pricing is settled and I do not want to revisit it: nineteen euro a month, ten episodes included, no overage. The eleventh episode just waits until the next month. Hosting goes on the same cloud provider I already use for my other project, that is decided too.
